patch_list: Custom fonts
Adds separate private TTF/OTF imports for native app text and reader text in Settings > Patch controls.
Disable Firebase Analytics
Deactivates Firebase Analytics collection in this build. Other trackers, anti-tamper reports and reading statistics stay unchanged. Repatch to restore collection; this is not ban protection.
Disable reader reward timer
Adds a switch to hide the reader's corner widget and stop its timer. Reading rewards from this timer stop while disabled.
GmsCore support (MicroG)

Routes Google Play Services calls through MicroG instead of real GPS. Works for: Google apps (YouTube, Maps, News, Photos) and third-party apps using classic Google Sign-In (Android 13 and below). Does not work for: Android 14+ Credential…
Hide ads
Hides the launch splash promotion, bottom-bar campaign button, reader bottom banner, chapter-end ad, Library promoted book and daily recommendation. Opt-in rewarded ads stay available.
Hide popups

Hides promotional and nag popups: home campaign popups and floating banners, the automatic check-in modal, notification permission nags, automatic rating prompts and the popups shown when leaving the reader. Adds a separate switch for the…
Main navigation controls
Adds persistent reorder and show/hide controls for the main bottom tabs. Opens Library at launch when Featured is hidden. Keeps Library, Profile and native Writing availability intact.
Material You colors
Adds wallpaper-based native app colors and a separate reader page/text palette on Android 12+. Preserves saved reader presets and layouts.

Spoof app signature

Makes the app think its signing certificate is unchanged after Morphe re-signs it. Useful when an app crashes or shows a tamper warning because it checks its own certificate. Does not bypass Play Integrity / SafetyNet hardware attestation.…
